question: who did puss in boots grew up with

passages.text: Who did Puss in Boots grow up with? The film's flashback answers that directly: Billy Bartholomew Goose, an eager, round-faced boy who lived at the same orphanage. Their friendship runs through the entire plot, from the childhood dream of finding the beans to the sad disagreement that splits them. Billy bursts with ideas and talks a mile a minute, while Puss mostly rolls his eyes and goes along with it. Reviewers often say the movie works because the sweetness of that early bond makes the later betrayal land harder than it otherwise would.
